title: Five Winters and One Short Note
subtitle: 影视欣赏 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 影视欣赏（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育）
meta: 主题语境：影视欣赏（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育）　|　核心词汇：episode　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 episode 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 my brother ① watched an episode that no teacher in the class would have chosen, and he said the watching was the whole of the winter. The ② episode, meaning the part itself and not the series, ran five winters and stayed unchosen in the book; an episode, he said, is the only thing in a class that is judged by how long it is left unchosen.

Every ③ episode in that class had the same short note beside it, and the ④ episode at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the weekend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An episode, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to choose; my brother said the choosing is the part that fills five winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the episode was the whole of the story, meaning the event and not the part. The ⑥ episode, meaning the event and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody waits for and nobody chooses; episode, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both a part and an event. He said the event is the part they remember.

By 1984 the ⑦ episode had become a line in a schedule, and the schedule had become an argument about the short note. The ⑧ episode of the whole thing, my brother wrote in January, was one class and five winters of choosing; episode, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to choose. He said the choosing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ episode I remember is the one chosen in the schedule, which closed in 1986 and is still described as the quietest in the class. An ⑩ episode, my mother said in 1988, is the only one that improves by being chosen; every episode, she said, is an event that has agreed to look like a part. She said the event was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 一集；一期（指班上每一集旁边的那一集）
B. n. 一集（指那一集本身，与整部剧相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch an episode 看一集
D. n. 一集（指留给周末的那一集）
E. n. 插曲；片段（抽象总称，指一段经历中的事件之事）
F. n. 一集（指节目表上写到、被排定的那一集）
G. n. 事件；插曲（指故事里人人都等却无人讲述的那样东西）
H. n. 事件（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人讲述的那种事情）

items.q: watched an episode that no teacher in the class would have chosen
The episode, meaning the part itself and not the series
the episode at the far side

The episode of the whole thing

answers.why: watch an episode 意为“看一集”，1979 年哥哥看了班上没有一位老师肯选的那一集。
episode 意为“一集”，指那一集本身而不是整部剧，它经过了五个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
episode 意为“一集”，指班上每一集旁边的那一集，每一集旁边都有同一张短短的字条。
episode 意为“一集”，指留给周末的那一集，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
episode 意为“事件、插曲”，指故事里人人都等却无人讲述的那样东西，叔叔说这个事件就是那个故事的全部。
episode 意为“事件”，指人人都等却无人讲述的那种事情而不是那一集，是故事里人人都等、却无人讲述的东西。
episode 意为“一集”，指节目表上写到、被排定的那一集，到 1984 年这一集成了节目表里的一行。
episode 意为“插曲、片段”，哥哥一月写道，整件事的事件之事是一个班级和五个冬天的选择。
episode 意为“一集”，我记得的是节目表上排定的那一集，1986 年结束了，至今仍被说成班上最安静的一集。
episode 为抽象总称，母亲 1988 年说，一集是唯一会因为被好好选择而变得更好的东西。
